Very good game. I totaly recommend it if you love the 40k universe. I use to prefer RTS's but had a lot of fun with that one. I even played it twice (medium then harder difficulty). The gameplay is good, the music is epic and fits perfectly the different moments of the story. The scenario is good, the voice actors did an excellent job...
The multiplayer (capture the flag; deathmatchs; last man standing...) is OK if you are into that kind of gameplay (not realy my type). Unfortunately you can't create a solo game against bots, or invite a friend to duel one vs one, but it's OK.

That being said, I only have one thing to add: WE WANT EPISODE 2!!!!!!!
Alas, "Hope is the first step on the road to disapointment"

The Emperor protects...

Just finished rerunning Warhammer 40,000; Space Marine and as a game, it truly stands the tests of time, but you can't help but feel robbed upon completion. Overall, the game is definitely worth playing, and has content for post end game of the campaign for those interested, but it is limited to community matches with friends.

When released, it captured what was great about shooters which were dominating the genre at the time, the Halo franchise being an example (And in fact, it filled a void in the market for many who were interested in a fast paced game as such). The graphics were amazing; game play fluid, and intense; plot devices and build up of story were perfectly executed. Overall, it was a perfect piece of work. 

However, all of it was for nothing. The marketing of the game at the time didn't offer much exposure. The multiplayer had budgets cut (Favouring  P2P hosting instead of dedicated servers), and overall the financial collapse of THQ put the nails in the coffin. The game was the 1st of what was meant to be 3 instalments. Sadly, whilst the plot has been released due to constant questions from the fan base, it just leaves you with a sense of yearning more, which will likely never be delivered. 

If you complete the game though, there is still more for those who have had an interest in the Warhammer digital games. The popular arena style games from Dawn of War is playable as a 1st person shooter. As stated, there is online games (Which are playable in small groups amongst friends in private lobbies), and you can rerun the game time and time again, and it never gets dull.

If anybody is looking for a game to sink there teeth in, definitely worth it and would recommend again, and again.
Oh baby...i think Warhammer found their genre to fall back on.

Great game for both causual gamers and fans of the 40k universe. The story is interresting with a memoriable main charater, though I havnt tried the multiplayer yet and im not sure if the servers are even running anymore after all these years but the custimization in both the loadout and your space marine apperance is a great feature. shooting and slicing through waves of orks and demaons is so much fun and addicting. I just finished the final boss which was fustrating to no end but damn did it feel good to finaly beat it. A sequal to this game is despratly needed.

Probably my favorite 40k game, played it when it first came out on 360. Most other 40k games don't make you feel like a badass Space Marine, this one nails it on the head. In both campaign and multiplayer. Problem is it's so old now that multiplayer is borderline dead. It's worth it at a discount price.
